name: contentasoft-mcp-launcher
description: Builds the four @contentasoft/*-mcp launcher packages and their MCP registry server.json files.

scripts.pack: node scripts/build.mjs && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true})" && cd packages/contenta-converter-mcp && npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist && cd ../videorecompress-mcp && npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist && cd ../ai-video-enhancer-mcp && npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist && cd ../cad-converter-mcp && npm pack --pack-destination ../../dist
